newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Exiled Bulgaria king arrives on pre-election visit.
newsitem.headline: Exiled Bulgaria king arrives on pre-election visit.

text.p: Exiled King Simeon arrived in northern Bulgaria on Tuesday on his second visit to the homeland he fled as a child in 1946.

Simeon flew into an airfield near the town of Veliko Tarnovo, where he will attend ceremonies for the anniversary of Bulgaria's first constitution. Parliamentary elections are set for Saturday, but aides say Simeon's visit is not political.
Simeon was greeted by a crowd of about 3,000 people waving national and monarchist flags and chanting his name. Girls in national costume offered bread and salt in a traditional gesture of welcome.

"The King is in no position to influence Bulgarian politics directly but he can always show his support for a particular political force or political trend," said Ahmed Dogan, whose ethnic Turkish Movement for Rights and Freedoms is contesting the elections in coalition with the main monarchist movements.
The King will stay overnight at the mountain village of Arbanassy, in a residence built and used by former communist dictator Todor Zhivkov.
On Wednesday, he will fly to Sofia for lunch with President Petar Stoyanov before returning to Madrid.
